overview_description.description:
99dresses allows users to trade the fashion items with other users.

The site started as a post-HSC  project for the founder, Nikki Durkin, in a collaboration between herself and Pollenizer, around December 2010, Pollenizer and 99dresses parted ways.

In November 2011, it was announced that 99dresses / Nikki would be participating in a YCombinator Program ([source](http://www.smh.com.au/technology/technology-news/aussie-nikki-joins-silicon-valley-millionaire-factory-20111118-1nlud.html)).

competitors_list.target_short_description: Rent the Runway is an online e-commerce website that allows women to rent designer apparel and accessories.
Nuuly is a clothing subscription rental experience from the Anthropologie, Free People and Urban Outfitters family.
Armoire is a clothing rental service, enabling customers to borrow contemporary women's clothing and swap anytime.
Poshmark is a social marketplace for fashion where anyone can buy, sell, and share their style with others.
Depop is a C2C fashion marketplace that provides a mobile application allowing users to buy, sell, discover, and explore various products.
Vinted is an online marketplace and community for second hand clothes.
ThredUp is a fashion resale marketplace that enables individuals to buy and sell clothing for women and children.
The RealReal is an online marketplace for authenticated and consigned luxury goods.
ReFashioner is a fashion-related e-commerce platform that offers designer and vintage pieces owned by other people.
Swap.com leads the low-priced online pre-owned clothing consignment segment in the U.S. due to its unique deep neural network AI.
GlamCorner is Australia's leading online designer dress hire destination for all of life's special occasions.
